subject: Use Shiny app as back-end for table from PostgreSQL DB

messages.author: 4645cc5ff080ea4f
messages.subject: Use Shiny app as back-end for table from PostgreSQL DB
parts:
Hi,

I am creating an application from which I can control particular table in PostgreSQL database. 

I want three main functionalities with this app:
1. See table in shiny app. Table should change if something is added/removed from table
2. Add row to table
3. Remove row from table.

So far I have accomplished 2 and 3, but I have some problems with 1 one. I cannot make table reactive, that is, if I add or remove something from table it doesn't change in my application.
I am checking if table is actually changed after adding or removing from database and it is. But since table is rendered on initial run, it doesn't change interactively.



Any advice would be vital!


Here is my code:


############
server.R:
############

library(RPostgreSQL)

country <- "us"

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  
  queryReturn <- function(q) {
    driver <- dbDriver("PostgreSQL")
    connection <- dbConnect(driver,user="USER", password="PSW", 
                            host="H.O.S.T", dbname="NAME")
    on.exit(dbDisconnect(connection),add=TRUE)
    result <- dbSendQuery(connection,q)
    result <- fetch(result,n=-1)
    return(result)
  }
  
  TableName <- paste0("r_plugin_test_",country)
  
  output$Table <- renderTable({
    queryReturn(paste0("select * from ",TableName))
  })
  
  output$lowValueRemove <- renderUI({
    c <- queryReturn(paste0("select * from ",TableName))
    selectizeInput("removeLowList","REMOVE",choices=c, multiple=TRUE)
  })
  
  observe({
    input$removeLow
    isolate({
      values <- setdiff(queryReturn(paste0("select * from ",TableName))$useless,input$removeLowList)
      queryNoReturn(paste0("delete from ",TableName))
      queryNoReturn(paste0("insert into ",TableName, " values ",paste0(paste(paste("('",values, sep=""),"')",sep=""),collapse=",")))
      })
  })
  
  output$lowValueAdd <- renderUI({
    c <- c("k","j","l")
    selectizeInput("addLowList","ADD",choices=c, multiple=TRUE)
  })
  
  observe({
    input$addLow
    isolate({
      values <- union(queryReturn(paste0("select * from ",TableName))$useless,input$addLowList)
      queryNoReturn(paste0("delete from ",TableName))
      queryNoReturn(paste0("insert into ",TableName, " values ",paste0(paste(paste("('",values, sep=""),"')",sep=""),collapse=",")))
      
    })
  })
  
}
)

###########
ui.R
###########

shinyUI(fluidPage(
  
  sidebarLayout(
    
    sidebarPanel(
      h5("Add & remove from PosgreSQL")
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      tableOutput("Table"),
      hr(),
      uiOutput("lowValueRemove"),
      actionButton("removeLow","REMOVE"),
      hr(),
      uiOutput("lowValueAdd"),
      actionButton("addLow","ADD"),
      hr()
    )
  )
))
